title: Book One · Chapter 10: The School Day
story:
On Thursday, Miss Wu writes three big words on the board: MAKE AND SHOW.

Leo reads them before she points.

"We will have a small class day in two weeks," she says. "Your grown-ups can come for the last part. You can make one thing. Then you can show it to us."

"Anything?" Leo asks.

"Please make a safe thing. You must carry it here. We need room for it too."

A child at the back asks about a dog. Miss Wu puts down her chalk.

"A dog is something alive, and you didn't make it."

The class laughs. The child laughs, too.

Miss Wu holds up a paper house. One wall is bent. The roof has a dark patch.

"My first try," she says. "You can show your first try too. Look at my bent wall! Your work can have mistakes too."

Ronan looks closely at the house. He can see a little chair inside. Miss Wu folded a paper strip. That is the little chair.

"Will people buy things?" he asks.

"This is a display. It isn't a sale. You can look for free."

She gives out a note for home. Miss Wu reads the note aloud. "Bring paper and card," she says. They may use clean old paper and small pieces of card. They must ask at home first. Then they can bring the paper to school. "Keep scissors on the tables," Miss Wu says. "Ask me first. Then you can use them."

"Can we make things together?" Leo asks.

"Yes. Put both names on the work. Tell me your plan by Friday."

Leo looks at Ronan. Ronan looks at the paper house.

At break, three children crowd around the front table. Mei, a girl from the next row, does not touch the house. She bends to look through the door.

"I want to draw a garden," she says.

"You could put it outside," Ronan says.

"I want to draw one. Not make this one."

She goes back to her own desk and draws a long leaf. Ronan watches her pencil. She keeps drawing the line. He looks at her leaf. His own leaves are just round shapes. He wants to try her shape later.

After school, Leo says, "I can make something with paper. It can move!"

"A bird?" Ronan asks.

"It will be bigger than a bird."

"A very big sleeping bird?"

Leo makes a face. "You'll see."

At home, Mum reads the note. Dad reads it after her. He puts it beside the tea box, away from the soup.

"Will there be prizes?" Ronan asks.

"No prize on this paper," Mum says. "Do you still want to make something?"

"No."

Dad takes a pencil and draws a line under the date. "I may have work that day. I can look at your thing at home, too."

Ronan looks down at the note. He wants Dad to come. He did not ask him first. Now he knows Dad may be busy. He runs his finger under the date.

Mum sees his face. "We can talk again next week. Then we can check the time."

"What about money for paper?"

"We can use our old paper first," Dad says.

Mum lifts an old shopping bag. Its sides are clean and brown.

Ronan spreads it on the table. Now the bag lies flat. It looks much bigger. He puts the school note beside it. Wind comes through the window. One paper corner lifts up. Ronan puts his book on it. The paper stays flat for him.
studyGuide:
## 先看情节提示也可以

老师说明手工展示的规则；Ronan听说没有奖项，先说不想做，后来仍拿出纸张。他也想让爸爸到场，但爸爸可能要工作。

## 从认词到读句子

1. **Mum / lifts / an old shopping bag.** 妈妈／拿起／一个旧购物袋。
2. **The paper / stays flat / for him.** 纸／保持平整／方便他使用；him指Ronan。

---

重点表达：display＝展示；together＝一起；by Friday＝到星期五之前；safe＝安全的。

理解问题：

1. 学校手工活动的规则是什么？
2. 孩子能否在课堂里自由收钱？
